legacy_root.question: Implementation target: a benchmark corpus with matched cases per family, each case carrying a deterministic postcondition oracle on the artifact produced - so a workflow's result is judged by what it produced on disk, not by what it reported.

schema_binding.note: WFA-0001 pack is absent on this worktree. This document is a BenchmarkResult-shaped corpus record, not a claim that the missing pack validated it.

tests_required: every oracle must be shown to reject a known-bad artifact before the corpus is used
at least one case per family, and families with no constructible case are reported as UNCOVERED
cases must be runnable without network access wherever possible, so results are reproducible
